patterns.signature: Night mid-block crossings vs fast eastbound cars
patterns.summary: 3 night-time close calls at the unsignalized mid-block crossing. 3 of 3 cars were above the 25 mph limit; the crossing sits in a gap between streetlights.

recommendations.name: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
recommendations.why: Pedestrians crossed at an uncontrolled mid-block location in all 3 events (EV_D1_0027, EV_D1_0062, EV_D2_0035); drivers gave no sign of expecting them.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

recommendations.name: Lighting
recommendations.why: All 3 events happened at night with the pedestrian between streetlight pools (EV_D1_0027, EV_D1_0062, EV_D2_0035).
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

recommendations.name: Medians and Pedestrian Refuge Islands in Urban and Suburban Areas
recommendations.why: Pedestrians had to judge both directions of fast traffic in one go (EV_D1_0027, EV_D1_0062, EV_D2_0035); a refuge splits the crossing.
recommendations.review_note: Suggested for traffic engineer review; not a verified design decision.

verification.reason: Car passes the unmarked crossing point 1.3s before the pedestrian steps into its lane.
